scope: 3 new connectivity/flow libraries; safe normal implementations; no edits to first-wave frozen graph libraries

provenance.reference_usage: AAL/Nyaan/Luzhiledの分類・数学的説明・問題選定を参考。LowLink/CSR Hierholzer/全グラフBellman-Ford付き最小費用流はいずれも独立実装。

sources.role: 公式原典でpublic-domain dedicationを確認。実装の転記はしない。
次数条件の数学的参考。破壊的なvector隣接実装と異なりCSRで非破壊に構築。
分類・問題選定の参考。独自の反復DFSと任意ブロック収集。
最小費用流の分類の参考。全域初期ポテンシャルと型範囲検査を自作。

reference_verification.Luzhiled: Official master/LICENSE is Unlicense/public-domain dedication as viewed, not asserted MIT. Documentation used for algorithm classification/existence conditions. No implementation copied; sources are own CC0 contributions.
reference_verification.Nyaan: Official graph catalogue and LowLink name/reference only; own iterative implementation with optional edge-block work.
reference_verification.LibraryChecker: Official repository task.md and example_00.in fetched for the four matching problems. Expected Euler output constructed by memoized exhaustive edge walks; component examples have a single 4-vertex component.
reference_verification.AtCoder: Official practice2 E statement and both official samples; negative costs are handled directly rather than shifted to an assumed nonnegative distribution.

coverage.LowLink: independent delete-one-edge/delete-one-vertex connectivity reference; bridges/articulation/two-edge groups; independent cycle-subset union reference for biconnected edge blocks; self/multiple edges;optional block collection;copy/move/rebuild;300000 path
coverage.EulerianTrail: independent exhaustive edge-walk existence for directed/undirected every valid start and circuit flag; IDs/vertices/orientation;loop/multiple/empty/disconnected;non-destructive repeat/copy/move;300000 path/cycle
coverage.MinCostFlow: independent enumeration of all feasible integer edge flows on DAG negative edges and globally nonnegative-cycle reweighted graphs; per-flow optimum;repeat/slope/max-cut/residual conservation;negative cycles disconnected and reachable;global feasible potential across source changes after canceling prior flow;change/reset;200000 path
coverage.cost_arithmetic: default extension and SIRKIT_FORCE_STANDARD_ARITHMETIC; full signed-cost max and min path sum; uint64 capacity max at zero cost; accumulated cost cancellation with intermediate product outside signedCost range;reverse CostMin rejection;overflow before current augmentation while retaining completed flow;uint8/int8 anduint32/int32
coverage.allocation: 68 injected bad_alloc and812 successful operations per configuration; LowLink build preserves previous result, Euler find is const, MinCostFlow preserves optimal completed augmentations and conservation, continuation reaches independently known optimum;zero live delta after destruction

min_cost_flow_contract.cost: signed integral at most64bits; original edges excludeCostMin to represent reverse
min_cost_flow_contract.working_values: reduced costs, tentative distances, potentials, marginal unit cost and each cumulative additional cost must fit Cost; overflow is an error even if some later final expression might cancel
min_cost_flow_contract.cycles: negative residual cycles anywhere are unsupported; initialize rejects via Bellman-Ford, unless overflow arises first
min_cost_flow_contract.initialization: virtual source to all vertices; no validation-only graph scan
min_cost_flow_contract.potential_update: h[v]+=min(dist[v],dist[t])-dist[t]; update settled vertices only after early target termination, others unchanged; preserves globally feasible potentials
min_cost_flow_contract.exception_guarantee: basic for flow/slope: completed augmentations may remain; all ownership valid, current augmentation not half-applied, invalid dual cache reset on arithmetic failure

online_status: All new drivers unsubmitted; local results are not online AC.
performance_status: No measurements made; CPU8 correctness only. Compilation/tests paused during parent P-Core measurement window.
